comparison.objective: Calibrate a mounted tool tip by touching one reference point from four distinct orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Submillimeter point maintenance while changing tool-axis direction and controlling light contact.
comparison.success_condition: Four one-second contacts, each 10–35° from vertical and ≥15° from prior axes; tool mount must remain fixed.
comparison.reason: Tests precision multi-pose contact calibration, not manipulation of loose materials.
